about: OpenAI errors mapped to per-item codes once a runner's own retries are spent. On HTTP 429, error.code credit_balance_exhausted and insufficient_quota mean account_not_entitled: someone must restore credit or raise the billing hard limit, rather than wait for a scheduled reset. Any other code, or none, keeps the status mapping, and a runner puts the unlisted code into the item error's message. Each item code's class, storage and stop follow vocabulary.json.
